name: deploy-cloud-sessions
description: A push to claude/** in taheri-pos goes live in both houses (scripts/cloud/deploy.sh)

steps.name: mirror.gcr.io/library/node:20
args: set -euo pipefail; rm -rf $$WORKDIR; git -c credential.helper='!f() { echo username=x-access-token; echo "password=$$DEPLOY_TOKEN"; }; f' clone --quiet https://github.com/Ammar282828/taheri-pos.git $$WORKDIR; cd $$WORKDIR; git config credential.helper '!f() { echo username=x-access-token; echo "password=$$DEPLOY_TOKEN"; }; f'; git fetch --quiet origin $$COMMIT; if git cat-file -e origin/main:scripts/cloud/deploy.sh 2>/dev/null; then git show origin/main:scripts/cloud/deploy.sh > /workspace/deploy.sh; else git show $$COMMIT:scripts/cloud/deploy.sh > /workspace/deploy.sh; fi; exec bash /workspace/deploy.sh
